name: Find the Lost Guards
summary: Guard Thomas waits at Elwynn's eastern bridge, needing news of two missing Stormwind guards.

sections.title: A Patrol Vanished
sections.body: At the crossing where the King's road nears Redridge, the riverbanks have grown more dangerous. Days ago, Thomas sent Rolf and Malakai north along the river to scout the murloc threat and clear their nests. Now he fears violence has stopped their patrol.

sections.title: Grim Discovery
sections.body: North along the river toward Stone Cairn Lake, swarming murlocs close around you. At the water's edge, you find a half-eaten corpse in the mud. An engraved medallion beside it bears the name Footman Malakai Stone. Malakai is dead, but Rolf is still missing.

faq.q: Who gave this quest and where are they located?
aliases: who starts find the lost guards
faq.answer: Guard Thomas is waiting beside the bridge at Elwynn Forest's eastern border, where the road leads toward Redridge Mountains.
Rolf and Malakai are two Stormwind city footmen. Guard Thomas sent them to scout the riverbanks and watch for aggressive murlocs.
Footman Malakai Stone's half-eaten remains lie on the river's eastern bank, just north of Guard Thomas's post and near the edge of a murloc settlement.
Local river murlocs overran Malakai and ate him. They infest the shores of eastern Elwynn Forest.
You find Malakai's remains alone by the river. Rolf is still missing, and his fate remains unknown as you track deeper into the murloc camps.

faq.q: Why were the guards sent out alone?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched thin across several territories. Small garrisons like Guard Thomas's rely on pairs of guards to patrol the wilderness borders.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you see how beast and murloc attacks threaten Elwynn's outer borders, even so close to Stormwind.
As a paladin, you can honor fallen defenders by recovering their insignia and bringing justice to those who guard the kingdom's frontier.
